input.body:
## Summary

Connect the recovered highlight rules and warning artwork to the live viewer, stacked on #94.

```text
stage step → inverse-transform pointer → card hit → lines / preview glow / caution
covered or detail view → suspend hover updates
new preview key/fit → paint immediately at current age
unmount → release four listeners and renderer filter
```

## Evidence

- **Before:** the new mock regression fails because frame-driven preview glow state is absent.
  **After:** header hover outside Load expands actual canvas ink, warnings follow signed alpha values, confirmation freezes an independent warning and selected glow clears.
- Formatting, TypeScript,573 rule/parser tests (6,602 assertions), production build and all18 distinct affected supplied-SWF/mock browser cases pass across broad/focused runs, without skips (14 cases1.7minutes; four code/fade cases31.8seconds). Captures inspected.
- Tests cover zero-origin240/256 and negative-residue reentry234/256 warning plateaus, new-page ink without ticking, four-to-zero subscription cleanup, random-empty artwork recovery, paging/pane transfer, local actions/guide persistence, creator routing and code/fade lifetimes.
- Runtime hook matches original1cfa745. Original UI/renderer deltas retain prior inverse contact, cancellation, source fades, loading cleanup, descriptions, eligibility and imported-data corrections. All16 original paths are accounted across #93/#94/this PR; none of these slices is counted landed yet.
- Pointer sampling currently uses native card-background alpha or the corresponding mock rectangle. Full descendant hit union, mock contours/fonts/code backdrop and synchronized original-runtime filter/event comparison remain explicit gaps; complete viewer/game parity is unproven.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert removes live hover effects and restores tick-only new-preview paint.

**Blast Radius:** viewer

Card input sampling, stage listener/filter lifetime and shared preview drawing. Existing callers default to no glow; no generated data, profile persistence, simulation rules or media changes.
